## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
If you have ideas on how to implement this, describe them here.

## County Support Request
If this is a request to add a new county:
- County Name: [e.g., Alameda County]
- Election Results URL: [paste URL]
- Platform Type: [if known, e.g., Clarity, LiveVoterTurnout, Custom]

## Alternative Solutions
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.

## Willing to Contribute
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this feature
- [ ] I can provide testing/feedback
- [ ] I can provide sample data or URLs
